gates.description: State machine JSON parses without error
gates.command: python -m json.tool authority-healing-state-machine.json
gates.failure_interpretation: JSON syntax error in state machine; fix and rerun

gates.description: State count in JSON matches markdown declaration of 32
gates.command: python -c "import json; sm=json.load(open('authority-healing-state-machine.json')); n=len(sm['states']); assert n==32, f'Expected 32, got {n}'; print(f'OK: {n}')"
gates.failure_interpretation: State count mismatch; REPAIR-001 not fully applied

gates.description: Taskcard schema JSON parses
gates.command: python -m json.tool taskcard-schema.json
gates.failure_interpretation: JSON syntax error in taskcard schema

gates.description: All taskcards JSON parses and has 25 taskcards
gates.command: python -c "import json; tcs=json.load(open('authority-healing-taskcards.json')); n=len(tcs['taskcards']); assert n==25, f'Expected 25, got {n}'; print(f'OK: {n}')"
gates.failure_interpretation: Taskcard count mismatch or JSON syntax error

gates.description: Taskcard validator passes (validate_repaired_plan.py exits 0)
gates.command: python validate_repaired_plan.py --run-dir .
gates.failure_interpretation: One or more plan validation checks failed; see raw-logs/validate-repaired-plan.txt

gates.description: State machine terminal states are complete (3 terminal states present)
gates.command: python -c "import json; sm=json.load(open('authority-healing-state-machine.json')); terminals=[s for s in sm['states'] if s.get('terminal')]; expected={'CLOSED_VERIFIED','CLOSED_WITH_AUTHORITY_DEBT','REJECTED_FALSE_CLAIM'}; actual={s['state_id'] for s in terminals}; assert actual==expected, f'Missing: {expected-actual}'; print('OK')"
gates.failure_interpretation: One or more terminal states missing

gates.description: Transition ledger is valid JSONL (each line parses)
gates.command: python -c "import json; [json.loads(line) for line in open('taskcard-transition-ledger.jsonl') if line.strip()]; print('OK')"
gates.failure_interpretation: Invalid JSONL; fix the malformed line

gates.description: Lane ownership map JSON parses
gates.command: python -m json.tool lane-ownership-map.json
gates.failure_interpretation: JSON syntax error in lane ownership map

gates.description: Lane count is 9 in lane ownership map
gates.command: python -c "import json; lm=json.load(open('lane-ownership-map.json')); n=len(lm['lanes']); assert n==9, f'Expected 9, got {n}'; print(f'OK: {n}')"
gates.failure_interpretation: Lane count mismatch; REPAIR-005 not fully applied

gates.description: No hardcoded Windows paths in repaired plan
gates.command: python -c "content=open('repaired-plan.md').read(); count=content.count('C:\\\\Users'); assert count==0, f'Found {count} hardcoded Windows paths'; print('OK')"
gates.failure_interpretation: Hardcoded Windows paths present; REPAIR-002 not fully applied

gates.description: No 'validated_by: human' as default in repaired plan
gates.command: python -c "import re; content=open('repaired-plan.md').read(); unsafe=re.findall(r'validated_by.*human(?!.*human_approval_required_reason)', content); assert len(unsafe)==0, f'Found unsafe: {unsafe}'; print('OK')"
gates.failure_interpretation: validated_by:human used as default; REPAIR-003 not fully applied

gates.description: No warning-only spec_fact_refs for new product work in repaired plan
gates.command: python -c "content=open('repaired-plan.md').read(); import re; warn=re.findall(r'(?:warn|warning).{0,50}spec_fact_refs|spec_fact_refs.{0,50}(?:warn|warning)', content, re.I); assert len(warn)==0, f'Found warning-only: {warn}'; print('OK')"
gates.failure_interpretation: spec_fact_refs still configured as warning-only; REPAIR-007 not applied

gates.description: No FODS-only narrowing (plan covers multiple formats, bypass pilot for non-FODS)
gates.command: python -c "content=open('repaired-plan.md').read(); assert 'gnumeric' in content.lower() or 'abw' in content.lower() or 'bypass' in content.lower(), 'FODS-only narrowing detected'; print('OK')"
gates.failure_interpretation: Plan only covers FODS; REPAIR-008 not applied

gates.description: No product implementation task in plan-repair sprint
gates.command: python -c "import json; tcs=json.load(open('authority-healing-taskcards.json')); bad=[t['taskcard_id'] for t in tcs['taskcards'] if any('src/' in str(p) for p in t.get('allowed_paths',[]))]; assert len(bad)==0, f'Tasks with src/ access: {bad}'; print('OK')"
gates.failure_interpretation: A taskcard has src/ in allowed_paths — plan-repair sprint must not touch src/

gates.description: TCA-000 NOT pre-marked CLOSED_VERIFIED at plan-repair sprint start
gates.command: python -c "import json; ts=json.load(open('taskcard-state.json')); s=ts['states']['TCA-000']['state']; assert s in ('IMPLEMENTING','IMPLEMENTED','VALIDATING'), f'TCA-000 should not be {s} at start'; print(f'OK: {s}')"
gates.failure_interpretation: TCA-000 pre-marked complete; REPAIR-004 not applied

gates.description: Rollback plan JSON parses and covers 12 failure modes
gates.command: python -c "import json; rp=json.load(open('rollback-recovery-plan.json')); n=len(rp['failure_modes']); assert n>=12, f'Expected >=12, got {n}'; print(f'OK: {n}')"
gates.failure_interpretation: Rollback plan has fewer than 12 failure modes; REPAIR-006 incomplete
